#### Load packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
fid_fusion = read.csv("input_data/data_city_river_fid_fusion.csv") %>% 
  select(c("fid", "fid_fusion"))

typology_names = read.csv("input_data/typology_names.csv", sep = ";") %>% 
  select(-name_fr)

topic_names4 = read.csv("input_data/topic_names4.csv") %>% 
  select(topic, name)
topic_names14 = read.csv("input_data/topic_names.csv") %>% 
  select(topic, name)
```

#### Load datasets

-   The segmented corpus with topics.

-   The website types for each web page.

-   The "localness" for each web page.

```{r retrieve_topics}
df_corpus = read.csv("analysis/clusters/segments_topics.csv") %>% 
  rename(page = segment,
         segment = doc_id)
```

```{r retrieve_website_types}
df_types = read.csv("analysis/typology_websites/corpus_website_types.csv") %>% 
  select(c("id", "type")) %>% 
  mutate(type = trimws(type)) %>% 
  rename(page = id)
```

```{r retrieve_localness}
data_clus = read.csv("analysis/localness/df_localness_cluster.csv") %>% 
  rename(fid = X) %>% 
  left_join(fid_fusion, by = join_by("fid" == "fid_fusion")) %>% 
  select(-"fid") %>% 
  rename(fid = fid.y)

df_localness = read.csv("analysis/localness/localness_compile.csv") %>% 
  mutate(hl = tolower(hl),
         page = paste0(fid, "_", hl, "_", X)) %>% 
  select(c("local_tld", "search_lang", "local_lang", "page"))
```

### For four discourse topics

#### Compile datasets

```{r}
df = df_corpus %>% 
  left_join(df_types, by = "page") %>% 
  left_join(data_clus, by = "fid") %>% 
  left_join(df_localness, by = "page") %>% 
  mutate(topic_ch = paste0("topic_", topic_4)) %>% 
  left_join(typology_names, by = join_by(type == nom)) %>% 
  select(-type) %>% 
  rename(type = name_en)
```

#### Get and plot specificities

```{r def_plot_specificities}
## based on the mixr function, with choice of colors 
plot_specificities2 = function(df_spec, 
                               cat1, 
                               cat2, 
                               x_label_name, 
                               colors = NULL, 
                               facet_labels = NULL){
  cat1 <- rlang::enquo(cat1)
  cat2 <- rlang::enquo(cat2)
  df_spec <- df_spec %>%
    dplyr::group_by(!!cat2)
  
  df_spec <- df_spec %>%
    dplyr::arrange(!!cat2,.data$spec)%>%
    dplyr::mutate(id=1:length(.data$spec))
  
  p=ggplot2::ggplot(df_spec,
                    ggplot2::aes(x = df_spec$id,
                                 y = df_spec$spec,
                                 fill = factor(!!cat2)))+
    ggplot2::geom_bar(stat="identity", alpha=0.8)+
    ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label=!!cat1, y=0), hjust=0)+
    ggplot2::coord_flip() +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA),
                                  expand = c(0, NA)) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(
      ggplot2::vars(!!cat2),
      scales="free",
      labeller = if(!is.null(facet_labels))
        ggplot2::labeller(.cols = facet_labels)
          else ggplot2::labeller(.default = label_value)
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(breaks=NULL)+
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position="none")+
    ggplot2::labs(x = x_label_name, y="Specificity score")
  
   if(!is.null(colors)){
    p <- p + ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = colors)
   }
  
  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
## WHAT / WHO
df_spec_what_who = mixr::tidy_specificities(df, topic_4, type) %>% 
  filter(topic_4 != "topic_NA") %>% 
  group_by(topic_4) %>% 
  top_n(4, spec)
# replace infinite values 
df_spec_what_who[sapply(df_spec_what_who, is.infinite)] = 324

plot_specificities2(df_spec_what_who, 
                    type, 
                    topic_4,
                    x_label_name = "Website type",
                    colors = c("topic_1" = "#fdb462",
                               "topic_2" = "#f781bf",
                               "topic_3" = "#b3de69",
                               "topic_4" = "#8dd3c7"),
                    facet_labels = c("topic_1" = "Topic 1 - Society",
                                     "topic_2" = "Topic 2 - Recreation",
                                     "topic_3" = "Topic 3 - Water quality",
                                     "topic_4" = "Topic 4 - Water quantity"))
ggsave("analysis/correlations_WWW/plot_what_who.png", width = 2000, height = 1200, units = "px")
ggsave("analysis/correlations_WWW/plot_what_who.svg", width = 2000, height = 1200, units = "px")
```

### For fourteen discourse topics

#### Compile datasets

```{r}
df14 = df_corpus %>% 
  left_join(df_types, by = "page") %>% 
  left_join(data_clus, by = "fid") %>% 
  left_join(df_localness, by = "page") %>% 
  mutate(topic_ch = paste0("topic_", topic_14)) %>% 
  left_join(typology_names, by = join_by(type == nom)) %>% 
  left_join(topic_names14, by = join_by(topic_ch == topic)) %>% 
  select(-type, -topic_ch) %>% 
  rename(type = name_en,
         topic = name) %>% 
  mutate(cluster = paste0("cl_", cluster))
```

### Local vs non-local discourses

#### Compile datasets

```{r}
df_types2 = read.csv("analysis/typology_websites/corpus_website_types.csv") %>% 
  select(id, type, query) %>% 
  rename(google_query = query) %>% 
  mutate(type = trimws(type)) %>% 
  rename(page = id)

df = df_corpus %>% 
  left_join(df_types2, by = "page") %>% 
  left_join(data_clus, by = "fid") %>% 
  left_join(df_localness, by = "page") %>% 
  mutate(topic_14 = paste0("topic_", topic_14),
         topic_4 = paste0("topic_", topic_4)) %>% 
  left_join(typology_names, by = join_by(type == nom)) %>% 
  left_join(topic_names14, by = join_by(topic_14 == topic)) %>% 
  left_join(topic_names4, by = join_by(topic_4 == topic)) %>% 
  select(-type) %>% 
  rename(type = name_en,
         name_4 = name.y,
         name_14 = name.x) %>% 
  mutate(cluster = paste0("cl_", cluster))
```

#### Dissimilarity between local and non-local discourse

```{r}
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)

res = df %>% 
  group_by(fid, google_query, topic_4) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(fid, google_query), values_from = count, names_from = topic_4) %>% 
  mutate(total = topic_1+topic_2+topic_3+topic_4) %>% 
  mutate(topic_1 = topic_1/total*100,
         topic_2 = topic_2/total*100,
         topic_3 = topic_3/total*100,
         topic_4 = topic_4/total*100) %>% 
  group_by(fid) %>% 
  summarise(distance = as.numeric(dist(as.matrix(across(starts_with("topic"))), method = "manhattan")))

data = read.csv("input_data/data_city_river.csv") %>% 
  left_join(res, by = "fid") %>% 
  select(c(fid, latitude, longitude, distance, urban_aggl)) %>% 
  mutate(longitude = as.numeric(str_replace_all(longitude, ",", "."))) %>% 
  mutate(latitude = as.numeric(str_replace_all(latitude, ",", "."))) 
data_sf = st_as_sf(data, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)

world_map = ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf") %>% 
  filter(sovereignt!="Antarctica")

world_map %>% 
  ggplot() +
  # world map 
  geom_sf(fill = "#f0f0f1", color = "white", size = 0.2) +
  # city points
  geom_sf(data = data_sf, aes(color = distance), size = 3) +
  # color palette
  # equal earth projection
  coord_sf(crs = "+proj=eqearth") +
  # theme
  theme_void()
```
